; ModuleID = 'testdata/invoke/in.txt'
source_filename = "testdata/invoke/in.txt"
target datalayout = "e-p:64:64-i64:64-n32:64-S128"

declare ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64)

declare i32 @personality(...)

declare void @external(ptr)

define void @read_invoke(ptr %p) {
entry:
  %v = load i8, ptr %p, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @known_invoke() personality ptr @personality {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  invoke void @read_invoke(ptr %p.stack)
          to label %done unwind label %failed

done:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret void

failed:                                           ; preds = %entry
  %landing = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
          cleanup
  resume { ptr, i32 } %landing
}

define void @unknown_invoke() personality ptr @personality {
entry:
  %p = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  invoke void @external(ptr %p)
          to label %done unwind label %failed

done:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret void

failed:                                           ; preds = %entry
  %landing = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
          cleanup
  resume { ptr, i32 } %landing
}
